thread:
Nora (People Ops): Quick check: new interviewer onboarding checklist missing step to validate Greenhouse scorecard permissions. Noticed a new contractor couldn't submit numeric scores.
Diego (Recruiter): Oh no, that explains the blank rows in yesterday's debrief. I added them as a collaborator but didn't toggle 'Can score'.
Lia (Hiring Manager): That's a recurring issue with temp interview panels. We should include a pre-panel verification task.
Asha (Recruiting Ops): Agree. Suggestion: add a two-step gate - 1) recruiter verifies GH 'score' permission, 2) People Ops runs a permissions audit script 24h before panel.
onboard-bot: :white_check_mark: New checklist item added by Diego: "Verify GH scoring permission".
Nora (People Ops): Nice. Can someone add a tiny script that checks permission flags for upcoming panelists? Lightweight lambda would do.
Asha (Recruiting Ops): I'll prototype a webhook that queries the GH API and posts any missing rights to #people-ops. Low-noise, only ping if any missing.
Diego (Recruiter): For existing candidates affected, can we retro-run and ask interviewers to re-enter numeric scores? I'd rather not lose debrief data.
Lia (Hiring Manager): For the two impacted candidates, yes please ask interviewers to re-submit before end of day. I'll pause decisions until we have numbers.
Nora (People Ops): Action items: Diego - message affected interviewers; Asha - prototype permission-check webhook; Nora - update interviewer onboarding checklist and send short blurb to temp hires.
onboard-bot: :rocket: Permission-check webhook prototype scheduled for staging deploy tomorrow.
